about: drawn after Unitree's product pictures of the Dex3-1 (unitree.com/Dex3-1: the hand upright beside an adult's hand, its sizes marked, and the hand on the G1), 2026-11-17: a hand black all over but for the grey metal blocks of the two fingers' knuckles at the palm's top; the palm a satin black shell; the fingers' and the thumb's first links black anodised aluminium frames, each holding a knurled black pad; the fingertips black rubber with a fingerprint's ridges (the Library's part, its cap drawn as the cap's hull: one mesh, one look).  Not modelled: the palm's knurled pad as a look of its own (the decimated palm keeps no clean edge round it), the screws (the meshes keep their holes), the cables.

tip-rubber.evidence: the hero picture: the fingertips are black rubber, #2b2e31 where a ridge is lit and #1a1b1c in the cap's middle, with a fine fingerprint's ridges and a soft sheen along the lit side, no sharp highlight

link-anodized.evidence: the hero picture: each finger's frame is black anodised aluminium, #1a1b1c on its broad faces with lit edges and screw heads at #434a59; satin, lighter than the rubber where it faces the light

pad-knurled.evidence: the hero picture: the knurled pads of the fingers' first links read #343943 to #3e4451, a matt black with no highlight, lighter than the frames round them (their knurl catches the light)

palm-satin.evidence: the hero picture: the palm is a smooth black shell with a broad soft highlight, #454547 to #656566 where it turns to the light and #0f0f10 to #212327 in shadow

knuckle-grey.evidence: the hero picture: the blocks at the base of the two fingers, at the palm's top, are grey metal, #7c8590 to #919aa5 under the studio's blue light, the one light metal of the hand.  At the homes the proximal links hide most of them: at the base look's metalness 1 with env_intensity 0.9 their slivers read #595c60 on average in the 2 mm Assembled picture (#6e7072 at the 90th percentile), darker than the photo; at metalness 0.5 and 1.6 (the I2RT YAM hub's way; the review of 2026-11-17) #777b7f, #9a9ea4 at the 90th percentile
